name: webGefaehrte Custom Functionality Plugin
upgrade_notice: Adds server-rendered, multisite-safe author profile fallbacks for GenerateBlocks author archives.
author: Jan (webGefährte)

sections.description:
webGefährte Custom Functionality Plugin centralizes shared website functionality across multiple WordPress installations. It provides reusable features such as custom fields, shortcodes, GeneratePress helpers, SMTP configuration and editorial enhancements without mixing in membership-specific logic.

  • Custom fields for posts, pages and supported CPTs
  • Shortcodes (TOC, reading time, glossary)
  • GeneratePress enhancements
  • Server-rendered author profile fallbacks for empty author archives
  • Scoped Contact Form 7 redirect handling
  • SMTP configuration support
  • Ratgeber permalink support for posts
sections.installation:
1. Download the latest ZIP package.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload and install the ZIP file.
  4. Activate the plugin.

  • Resolve avatars through the WordPress avatar API for multisite compatibility
  • Whitelisted and escaped display name, first name and last name output
  • Preserve existing profile data and add accessible avatar alt text
  • Documented a configurable 150px fallback avatar size
